wards.name: the brass gate
wards.denied: A gate of verdigris-crusted brass, locked into the sandstone archway. Shatter it, or turn the warden's key, and not otherwise.
wards.opened: The brass gate shrieks and falls outward into the dunes.

spots.line: Beyond the brass gate the stairs plunge beneath the desert floor into absolute black.
Pillars scored by ten thousand sandstorms, their inscriptions ground smooth.
Sun-bleached bones of a desert lizard, half-covered by drifting silt.
The stone threshold is hot enough to blister leather.

chests.line: A caravan chest thrown against the sandstone base, baked dry.
Sunken coins welded together by ancient heat.
Past the brass portal, resting in an altar niche untended for centuries.

people.name: Hamid the Sunwarden
chatter: Nothing walks out of this gate in the daylight. In the dark, we do not sleep.
The heat in the sands is nothing compared to the heat two flights below.
Check your water skins before you step past the threshold.

people.name: Farouq, watching the horizon
chatter: Heat shimmering off the dunes plays tricks on eyes.
If the brass rings begin to vibrate, step back immediately.
